cross_cutting_constraints.rule: Retain every existing cooldown, mana cost, target query, payload time, velocity, hitbox/radius, attack ownership and support interval. No added input, combo, or wind-up gating.

Drive lifetimes and cosmetic animation by battle elapsed/paused truth; stop particles/afterimages on pause, do not use wall-clock to expire them. Existing AnimatedSprite controllers are process-disabled while paused.

Separate successful cast identity (source,cast), delivery (delivery), target and state-instance identity. Existing cast:kind dedupe is inadequate as a universal future lifecycle key. Do not replay launch for each target; do not erase distinct repeated echo/pulse deliveries.

Only confirmed facts or read-only snapshots create benefit/contact/status effects. Zero resource delta/capped heal, misses, no-eligible extension and failed paid requests must not show a false benefit.
Author world footprints against real geometry; assess silhouette, contrast and text/icon minimum size at camera zoom and 940/1280 layouts. Do not increase collision/world range to enlarge the effect.

Keep actor.position at feet, red core fixed at H.center and radius4. Friendly effects must not obscure controlled red dot, real hostile projectiles or committed warnings; preserve existing top draw order.

Respect reduced_motion/reduced_flash and bounded contacts/numbers/voices; strengthening is not blanket camera shake, white flash, hitstop or more concurrent audio. New cosmetic randomness must not touch gameplay RNG.

Rear characters have no separate battlefield position. Show source in bounded overlay/portrait/launch signature, retain immutable launch owner across switch; never invent additional collidable party bodies.

style_dispatch.note: Only F11/F03/F07 identities are handled; fallback returns empty.

authored_dedupe.note: Key has cast and effect kind; lacks source/delivery/target. Repeated original-cast echo or multi-target impacts can coalesce while seen survives.
authored_dedupe.epistemic_status: code-condition inference from current cache key/lifetime, not an executed gameplay repro

authored_lifetime.note: Short transients persist .72/.42 seconds independently of original .22 descriptor; not status lifetime.

authored_recipient.note: Heal/ward transient only drawn if current actor is a beneficiary; origin stays original cast.origin.

authored_shield.note: Dedicated polygon is restricted to currently controlled F03; generic foot shield ring also exists.

actor_dispatch.note: M01-M06 friendly, F02-F10 women, JIA, otherwise mage/gun/sword role scenes.

body_scale.note: Shared standing body height; crouches preserved.

cast_animation.note: Only current actor direct effects with newer cast; one selected per refresh, manual priority; support/secondary cannot animate an absent rear body.

generic_fx.note: JIA substitution only slash/ring; generic effect_frames cover slash/ring/cast, not impact.

projectile_fx.note: Friendly authored projectile override or shared three ART.BOLTS textures.

draw_order.note: Hostile projectiles and player red hurtbox draw after friendly effects.

pause_visual.note: Actor animation disabled on pause; transient clock from battle elapsed.

cast_fact.note: Successful activation only emits cast after MP/CD commitment. No gameplay wind-up is present.

benefit_fact.note: Actual positive hp/mp/shield deltas per recipient; cast origin position, not separate rear body coordinates.

effect_descriptor.note: Launch/payload descriptor; contains cast/source/ability/direct/time and beneficiary ids, but no delivery/target/secondary/mechanic.

damage_fact.note: Confirmed positive applied damage with source/ability/mechanic/cast/delivery/target/world position.

projectile_contact.note: Geometric projectile collision; queued before final damage resolution, must not equate with positive health loss.

delivery.note: New delivery counter separates repeated payload resolutions; does not change original cast identity.

ability_gate.note: Failed level/CD/MP/target checks do not pay or commit successful cast.

contact_budget.note: Only direct nonsecondary real damage; max3 contacts/cast, normal enemies within260, elites/bosses prioritized.

audio_facts.note: Successful cast cue and real damage/benefit impact cue; secondary/periodic skipped except guard_counter.

feedback_visual.note: Visual match handles damage/kill/player_hit/pickup/level/elite; no ability_effect or mechanic branch.

feedback_guard.note: Visual guarded flag uses absorbed shield without hp loss; real guard reduction with positive hp loss remains hurt-colored despite event.guarded.

hud_status.note: Echo/ammo/refund/relay/mark/guard/temper and shield already have HUD text. No curse/rally branch.

state_status.note: Read-only projection has character windows; no enemy curse/exposure list or deployed fields.

special_payload.note: Special guard/temper/rally/field/extend/settle alter runtime state without dedicated visual lifecycle facts.

paid_chain.note: Only paid>0 manual nonsecondary chain; visual changes must never re-emit cast or gameplay hits.

echo_fact.note: Retains original cast/source; executes payload and emits mechanic echo; no new cast fact.

secondary.note: Clears direct/enchant/manual/basic/paid/mechanic/params and spark fields; secondary effects must retain identity without re-entering chain.

hit_mechanics.note: Curse/expose application and cashout occur on actual hit; not on launch.

guard_fact.note: Guard charge consumed on real received hit; counter is secondary, has guard_counter ability and delivery.

state_tick.note: Finite windows/echo/refunds/exposures/curses/fields expire on simulation time; no uniform end events.

refund_fact.note: mechanic refund includes payer, actual capped amount, balance; ignored by current visual feedback.

field_pulse.note: Pulse queues damage and directly adjusts receivers hp/mp, then ring effect; bypasses _execute_payload benefit delta event.

shared_core.note: Fixed foot+(0,-36) red danger core, radius4; presentation may not alter either.

scale_camera.note: Camera world scale can shrink; readability must be checked in screen space without changing world damage geometry.

women_action.note: HEAL/MANA/WARD select cast; all other skills attack. Immediate attack starts contact frame1.

jia_action.note: Weapon-specific dao/spear clips start contact frame1; manual flag protects ongoing manual action.

friendly_action.note: Requests effect.action but current effect descriptor has no action; falls back manual=special, other=attack.
friendly_action.epistemic_status: static producer/consumer field comparison, not a native animation test

sword_no_action.note: Only locomotion API; full source has no present_cast/play_attack.

mage_no_action.note: Embedded visual script only locomotion API; no present_cast/play_attack.

gun_no_action.note: Embedded visual script only locomotion API; no present_cast/play_attack.

verification.method: stdlib parse + exact source anchors + existing asset paths + source hashes; no runtime mutation or render/test execution
